parsed.summary: Under general direction of the CalFresh E&T Program Director, provide a full range of advanced technical and programmatic leadership for the statewide evaluation program. This includes the services related to the planning, design, implementation, and evaluation of consumer, intermediary, and systems approaches. The evaluation analyst will oversee the statewide evaluation of CalFresh E&T, UC programming. Serve as one of the lead staff to design and provide recommendations for improvement of program planning, development and implementation on how the evaluation can provide findings for an integrated statewide approach. The evaluation design will conform to the USDA Evaluation Framework. Requires work with other CalFresh E&T, academics and staff to provide overall leadership for the training and technical assistance to build the capacity of staff to plan, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art SNAP workforce development education programs and curriculum. Review current literature and journals to stay on top of emerging evaluation approaches and tools. Work with subcontractors to identify best approaches for measuring education at the community, county and state levels. Provide recommendations on the evaluation of conferences, workshops, and trainings.

ksas: Experience as an evaluator with facilitation, collaboration, and community-relations skills. Experience working on community-based program evaluations, including community-based and public health or health service organizations. Organizational and time management skills to manage multiple projects and logistical details, develop evaluation plans and data collection instruments, and assume independent responsibility for work outcomes as well as work on a team. Qualitative and quantitative research skills including knowledge of evaluation design and methodology with a successful track record in high quality data collection and analysis, and dissemination of results. Skills to facilitate the planning and implementation process, provide timely and frequent progress and other findings that are used to improve the community intervention strategies. High level interpersonal, customer-focused and communication skills to build rapport and trust in an underserved, politically charged, and/or multi-disciplinary community leadership situation.. Computer skills including fluency with Microsoft Office Suite software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) to produce well-crafted reports and clearly present complex information to various audiences.

Experience designing evaluation studies, methods, tools and instruments to measure workforce development training. Skills to conduct descriptive statistical analysis of data using computer software (i.e., SPSS). Experience providing training and technical assistance. Knowledge of adult education concepts. Broad knowledge of current scientific research-based principles, theories, and practices of community-based education. Knowledge of technology and other approaches for training such as webinars and distance learning.

Job Summary:
Under general direction of the CalFresh E&T Program Director, provide a full range of advanced technical and programmatic leadership for the statewide evaluation program. This includes the services related to the planning, design, implementation, and evaluation of consumer, intermediary, and systems approaches. The evaluation analyst will oversee the statewide evaluation of CalFresh E&T, UC programming. Serve as one of the lead staff to design and provide recommendations for improvement of program planning, development and implementation on how the evaluation can provide findings for an integrated statewide approach. The evaluation design will conform to the USDA Evaluation Framework. Requires work with other CalFresh E&T, academics and staff to provide overall leadership for the training and technical assistance to build the capacity of staff to plan, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art SNAP workforce development education programs and curriculum. Review current literature and journals to stay on top of emerging evaluation approaches and tools. Work with subcontractors to identify best approaches for measuring education at the community, county and state levels. Provide recommendations on the evaluation of conferences, workshops, and trainings.

Essential Responsibilities:
85% EVALUATION
  - Provide oversight and handle administration of Institutional Review Board (IRB) correspondence for CalFresh E&T, UC programming
  - and the local county projects including: Submission of new protocols, renewals or modifications, Ensuring appropriate staff are IRB certified and current, Handling all inquiries related to addition of new evaluation staff and ensuring oncoming evaluation procedures meet Human Subjects (IRB) approval

  - Updating tools as needed (electronic, website & portals)
  - Responding to data requests and inquiries from counties
  - Downloading, cleaning & analyzing county data
  - Summarizing data for counties in easy-to-read templates for use in their final reports
  - Merging county datasets for statewide analyses -Summarizing statewide data for final report
  - Providing program recommendations based on findings
  - Provide leadership in coordinating with the other State Implementing Agencies: Development, analysis and preparation of data reports for the USDA and CDSS, Assessment of evaluation needs and capacity of all state implementing agencies based on USDA Evaluation Framework and CDSS reporting
  - Organization, prioritization and delegation of new evaluation priorities to best meet the needs of CalFresh E&T
  - Creation of appropriate web based portals to collect impact and outcome data for CalFresh E&T, UC
  - Creation of Excel based aggregating evaluation tools
  - Preparation of written evaluation reports for statewide impacts and outcomes
  - Preparation of oral and written evaluation reports, briefings and assist in developing papers for publications and presentations.

15% TRAINING AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE
  - Direct training for CalFresh E&T, UC staff on program evaluation
  - Coordinate, provide training and technical assistance to assigned county program staff on USDA Evaluation Framework
  - program evaluation priorities and strategies and program reporting requirements. Participate in relevant state and/or federal workgroups or committees that involve and inform CalFresh E&T, UC program and evaluation efforts
  - Provide recommendations from other workforce developent program observations, evaluations and literature reviews for program development and improvement
  - Provide annual reviews & feedback for fiscal year reporting processes
  - Develop and deliver trainings, webinars and support materials to enhance program delivery based on evaluation and program reviews.

Education:
  - Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
  - Preferred: Master's degree in related field, or equivalent experience/training.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  - Experience as an evaluator with facilitation, collaboration, and community-relations skills. Experience working on community-based program evaluations, including community-based and public health or health service organizations. Organizational and time management skills to manage multiple projects and logistical details, develop evaluation plans and data collection instruments, and assume independent responsibility for work outcomes as well as work on a team. Qualitative and quantitative research skills including knowledge of evaluation design and methodology with a successful track record in high quality data collection and analysis, and dissemination of results. Skills to facilitate the planning and implementation process, provide timely and frequent progress and other findings that are used to improve the community intervention strategies. High level interpersonal, customer-focused and communication skills to build rapport and trust in an underserved, politically charged, and/or multi-disciplinary community leadership situation.. Computer skills including fluency with Microsoft Office Suite software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) to produce well-crafted reports and clearly present complex information to various audiences.
  - Experience designing evaluation studies, methods, tools and instruments to measure workforce development training. Skills to conduct descriptive statistical analysis of data using computer software (i.e., SPSS). Experience providing training and technical assistance. Knowledge of adult education concepts. Broad knowledge of current scientific research-based principles, theories, and practices of community-based education. Knowledge of technology and other approaches for training such as webinars and distance learning.
